name: Halfmoon
description: Half-discs pinned to one of the four edges, with the occasional full moon among them.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @pick(circle(50% at 50% 100%), circle(50% at 50% 0), circle(50% at 0 50%), circle(50% at 100% 50%)); clip-path: @pick(circle(50% at 50% 100%), circle(50% at 50% 0), circle(50% at 0 50%), circle(50% at 100% 50%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(0.22) { :after { -webkit-clip-path: circle(46% at 50% 50%); clip-path: circle(46% at 50% 50%); } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
